Kennedy Center Warns of Bankruptcy Amid Naming Dispute

The Kennedy Center in Washington D.C. has warned it faces bankruptcy unless former President Donald Trump's name is restored to its building. Reports indicate the center is in financial distress, with one nearby restaurant also reportedly pushed to the brink due to the situation. The specific financial figures or the exact nature of the dispute regarding Trump's name were not detailed in the coverage.
